wordbook.radicalDescription: The whole character is also the radical. It appears in many characters connected with people.
亻 is the side form of 人. It often marks characters related to a person or human action.
女 is the dictionary radical. Here it is one part of the complete character rather than a full definition.
女 places the character in a family of words historically associated with women.
宀 often appears in characters connected with houses, rooms, shelter, or things kept indoors.
The full character is the radical. Its side form 氵 appears in many liquid- and water-related characters.
火 is both a character and a radical. Its lower form 灬 often suggests heat, cooking, or fire.
木 often groups characters associated with trees, wood, and objects traditionally made from wood.
The radical commonly appears in characters connected with mountains, cliffs, and landforms.
日 often occurs in characters related to sunlight, daytime, dates, and time.
As a radical, 月 can represent the moon; a similar-looking form in other characters may come from flesh.
雨 often appears above characters for weather and atmospheric phenomena.
犭 is the side form of 犬, meaning dog. It is widely used in characters naming animals.
口 commonly appears in characters involving the mouth, speech, sounds, eating, or drinking.
The mouth radical points toward the physical action involved in drinking.
饣 is the simplified side form of 食. It often identifies food, meals, and eating-related words.
艹 is the top form of the grass radical and frequently marks plants, herbs, and plant products.
目 groups many characters connected with seeing, eyes, and visual attention.
讠 is the simplified side form of 言. It often appears in words involving language and communication.
钅 is the simplified side form of 金. Many characters in this family name metals or metal objects.
